Ivan Dmytrovych Sirko was born in the early seventeenth century, approximately between 1605 and 1610. This is evidenced primarily by the results of research on Sirko's remains, according to which the Cossack ataman was 70-75 years old at the time of his death in 1680. The first researcher of Sirko's biography, the famous Ukrainian historian Dmytro Yavornytskyi, suggested that the future ataman was born in Sloboda Ukraine in the settlement of Merefa (now the city of Merefa, Kharkiv region). However, this is not true. Merefa was founded only in 1658, i.e. when Sirko was in his late teens. However, Sirko and his family lived in Merefa for a long time in his house, and after his death, his wife and some family members lived there. The fact that Merefa in Slobozhanshchyna is associated with the name of the Cossack Ataman is evidenced by another name for the town recorded in some Ukrainian chronicles, Sirkivka. Where, then, should we look for Sirko's homeland? In our opinion, the sources give grounds to localize it in Eastern Podillia, namely in the Vinnytsia region. It is worth recalling that Sirko was a colonel in Vinnytsia (Kalnytsia) in 1658-1660. As you know, at that time in Ukraine, people who came from the local area were usually elected to such positions. Let us also recall a letter from Hetman of the Left Bank Ukraine Ivan Samoilovych to the tsarist voivode Prince G. Romodanovsky of April 20, 1675*, which recounts (in Russian) Sirko's own words: "And since I was born among the Poles, I want to die there." Thus, it is clear that Sirko was born on the Ukrainian lands that were under the rule of the Polish-Lithuanian Commonwealth, not Muscovy (the latter included Slobozhanshchyna). The historian Volodymyr Borysenko's assumption that Sirko's birthplace was the hundred-man town of the Bratslav regiment Murafa, a few kilometers from Kalnyk, is correct. Now it is the village of Zhdanov, Vinnytsia region. By the way, Murafa in the Slobozhanshchyna probably originated from this Murafa, because immigrants from the Right Bank of Ukraine to the Left Bank often gave the newly founded settlements the names of their native villages or towns. It is also worth noting Sirko's great interest in Keleberda, which he founded in 1675 on the left bank of the Dnipro. For a long time, he sought from the Moscow tsar the right to own this town or sloboda, as well as the strategically important crossing of the Dnipro near Perevolochna (Sirko wanted this crossing not for himself, but for the entire Zaporozhian Lowland Army). Contrary to popular belief, we believe that Sirko did not come from a Cossack family, but from a small Ukrainian Orthodox gentry. For example, we know the name of a Podillia nobleman, Voytekh Sirko, who was married to a certain Olena Kozynska. Sources mention them in 1592. It is possible that they were relatives of the Cossack leader. Perhaps it is no coincidence that the kings of the Polish-Lithuanian Commonwealth, writing to Sirko, called him "urodzon." The word "nobleman" evokes negative associations for many people due to stereotypes instilled in school textbooks of the Stalinist era. However, this approach is not always correct. The term "nobleman" is identical to the words "knight," "chevalier," "nobleman," etc. and was commonly used not only in Poland but also in Ukraine, Belarus, and the Czech Republic. If scholars in Russia, Poland, and the Czech Republic, having contracted vulgar sociologism, no longer accuse Pushkin or Bunin, Suvorov or Kutuzov, Žižka or Kostiushko of being of noble or gentry origin, why have attacks on the Ukrainian and Belarusian gentry continued until recently? Is it not because in this way the imperial "divide and conquer" was transferred to our long-suffering history? Was it not because it was necessary to impose a nihilistic attitude toward the history of Ukraine, to "prove" that Ukrainians or Belarusians were just dark labor without national consciousness, ethnographic material doomed to build other people's empires? Meanwhile, the Ukrainian gentry produced many outstanding sons of Ukraine, fighters for its freedom. Suffice it to mention the names of Kryshtof Kosinski, Petro Konashevych-Sahaidachny, Ivan Sulyma, Ivan Mazepa, Bohdan Khmelnytsky, and his associates: Ivan and Danylo Vyhovsky, Ivan Bohun, Danylo and Ivan Nechai, Mykhailo Krychevsky, Jan Sokolovsky, Siluyan Muzhylovsky, and others. Sirko's appearance and personality do not always coincide with the conventional ideas about him that have developed in some works of art. The Cossack leader was slightly taller than average (174-176 cm), had regular facial features, and a straight nose. By the way, the great Relin intuitively caught this when he depicted him in the center of his painting "Cossacks Writing a Letter to the Turkish Sultan." This is evidenced primarily by the results of research on Sirko's remains, according to which the Cossack ataman was 70-75 years old at the time of his death in 1680. The first researcher of Sirko's biography, the famous Ukrainian historian Dmytro Yavornytskyi, suggested that the future ataman was born in Sloboda Ukraine in the settlement of Merefa (now the city of Merefa, Kharkiv region). However, this is not true. Merefa was founded only in 1658, i.e. when Sirko was in his late teens. However, Sirko and his family lived in Merefa for a long time in his house, and after his death, his wife and some family members lived there. The fact that Merefa in Slobozhanshchyna is associated with the name of the Cossack Ataman is evidenced by another name for the town recorded in some Ukrainian chronicles, Sirkivka. Where, then, should we look for Sirko's homeland? In our opinion, the sources give grounds to localize it in Eastern Podillia, namely in the Vinnytsia region. It is worth recalling that Sirko was a colonel in Vinnytsia (Kalnytsia) in 1658-1660. As you know, at that time in Ukraine, people who came from the local area were usually elected to such positions. Let us also recall a letter from Hetman of the Left Bank Ukraine Ivan Samoilovych to the tsarist voivode Prince G. Romodanovsky of April 20, 1675*, which recounts (in Russian) Sirko's own words: "And since I was born among the Poles, I want to die there." Thus, it is clear that Sirko was born on the Ukrainian lands that were under the rule of the Polish-Lithuanian Commonwealth, not Muscovy (the latter included Slobozhanshchyna). The historian Volodymyr Borysenko's assumption that Sirko's birthplace was the hundred-man town of the Bratslav regiment Murafa, a few kilometers from Kalnyk, is correct. Now it is the village of Zhdanov, Vinnytsia region. By the way, Murafa in the Slobozhanshchyna probably originated from this Murafa, because immigrants from the Right Bank of Ukraine to the Left Bank often gave the newly founded settlements the names of their native villages or towns. It is also worth noting Sirko's great interest in Keleberda, which he founded in 1675 on the left bank of the Dnipro. For a long time, he sought from the Moscow tsar the right to own this town or sloboda, as well as the strategically important crossing of the Dnipro near Perevolochna (Sirko wanted this crossing not for himself, but for the entire Zaporozhian Lowland Army). Contrary to popular belief, we believe that Sirko did not come from a Cossack family, but from a small Ukrainian Orthodox gentry. For example, we know the name of a Podillia nobleman, Voytekh Sirko, who was married to a certain Olena Kozynska. Sources mention them in 1592. It is possible that they were relatives of the Cossack leader. Perhaps it is no coincidence that the kings of the Polish-Lithuanian Commonwealth, writing to Sirko, called him "urodzon." The word "nobleman" evokes negative associations for many people due to stereotypes instilled in school textbooks of the Stalinist era. However, this approach is not always correct. The term "nobleman" is identical to the words "knight," "chevalier," "nobleman," etc. and was commonly used not only in Poland but also in Ukraine, Belarus, and the Czech Republic. If scholars in Russia, Poland, and the Czech Republic, having contracted vulgar sociologism, no longer accuse Pushkin or Bunin, Suvorov or Kutuzov, Žižka or Kostiushko of being of noble or gentry origin, why have attacks on the Ukrainian and Belarusian gentry continued until recently? Is it not because in this way the imperial "divide and conquer" was transferred to our long-suffering history? Was it not because it was necessary to impose a nihilistic attitude toward the history of Ukraine, to "prove" that Ukrainians or Belarusians were just dark labor without national consciousness, ethnographic material doomed to build other people's empires? | [](https://substack.com/redirect/32cc4205-9935-4d94-898c-1c645d5f2374?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|

Last fall, Trump stood in the takeout window at a McDonald's in eastern Pennsylvania and promised to make things more affordable. A year later, the voters returned their verdict: he hasn't. It's likely that "affordability" became a buzzword after last week's elections because those elections were the only way people could think of to voice their frustrations.
In the first few months of Trump's term, many Democratic criticisms were couched as predictions or hypotheticals. But enough time has passed that now, we can see the real damage. Take, for instance, the [data](https://substack.com/redirect/57c111c3-2ebc-4d35-b56f-a1e1c27204cc?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) showing how Pennsylvania became the state with the highest increase in grocery costs of any state in the country. There's no good reason for that. We are centrally located, we have a major port, and we have enviable rail, highway, and river access to other ports. We have a large agricultural sector of our own, but this is where you start to see the struggle. The tariffs have driven up the costs of farming inputs, and worse than that, the markets themselves are warped. Consider this [explanation](https://substack.com/redirect/695c0739-ba84-4f14-b0a4-8207a408149a?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) by the head of Pennsylvania's Potato Growers Cooperative:
> _"[I]f you raise potatoes here in the Northeast you're always propped up against an Idaho russet, or a russet from Washington or Oregon," he says. "The three largest potato growing states are Oregon, Washington and Idaho, and those potatoes flow east. In order to compete, you must always match those prices, and if we can just get more of those potatoes out of our market, specifically into Japan, it would be a huge win."_
But potatoes aren't getting out of our market anymore, at least to the same degree, because of reciprocal tariffs imposed in response to ours. Similar dynamics are at play for dairy and hogs, both areas in which Pennsylvanians have long competed.
To make matters worse, Pennsylvania farmers are finding it harder to get workers into the market. Trump refuses to administer a better system for legal, seasonal immigrant farm labor; in fact, Stephen Miller made it his mission to drive immigrants into the shadows and deter them from coming here in the first place. The result can be catastrophic for ordinary Pennsylvanians. [Politico](https://substack.com/redirect/7eef1d5e-0c9a-4bac-a294-76af6f9d27ad?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) recently described a a multigenerational Pennsylvania dairy farm that sold all of its cows because the owner could not find anyone to milk them.
Of course, groceries are only the most visible and understandable metric of how Trump has made life more expensive in Pennsylvania. But the cost increases he inflicted in other sectors are even worse. CBS News recently [profiled](https://substack.com/redirect/20741f9c-f4c0-4ca7-b3ab-70e50c3506ff?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) some Pennsylvanians who signed on to Pennie (our state's ACA exchange) to buy health insurance for 2026, and now they are looking at premium increases so steep they may be out of reach:
> _Sarah Cunningham of Hatboro, said her premium will climb by more than 300%. She credits her coverage with saving her life after a cancer scare five years ago, but the price jump came as a shock. "I was expecting like 50%, but I wasn't expecting it to go up over three times the amount," Cunningham said. "Little things, like basic needs, I'm going to have to cut down on."_
And the question is why? The Sarah Cunninghams of the world were able to afford their healthcare in 2025, even if it wasn't easy. Why should they have to change their entire lives just to pay for the same thing in 2026? If Trump had been honest about that when he was in the McDonald's window, he never would have been elected.
Unfortunately the list goes on and on. The cost of raising a child in Pennsylvania [jumped](https://substack.com/redirect/c3d06183-a976-46b0-886b-4fbad34763b0?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) more than 13% from last year to this year. Half of [homes](https://substack.com/redirect/2a5b32cd-20d5-413f-9e07-1cfa2da75a0d?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) in our state now cost $325,000 or more. An especially heartbreaking [statistic](https://substack.com/redirect/b7a329c2-8dcd-40e7-b8bd-aa66ba3200d6?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) as we approach winter is that 338,000 Pennsylvanians had their utilities disconnected in the first nine months of 2025, a 16% increase compared to last year. This is as sure a sign as any that people just can't make ends meet.
These facts remind us what the Democratic position during the shutdown was really about. The issue of affordability is truly a crisis, and stopping the runaway increase in healthcare costs was the one, immediate tool available to make a difference. Neither party believes they can pass a bill that will quickly bring down the price of groceries. But Democrats argue, rightly, that a single bill restoring the ACA subsidies could make healthcare cost roughly the same price next year that it did this year. Instead, many people will go broke or go without. Those are their choices.
Next time you're in a crowded place, look around and realize that [one out of every four](https://substack.com/redirect/92aa985e-99f5-43a5-8ea8-90eed83991e4?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) people has _**no emergency savings at all**_. If you combine that with the people who have some emergency savings, but not enough for three months of expenses, you have _**more than half of everyone in our country**_**.** It is an enormous problem for people in a situation like this to have hundreds of dollars added on to their monthly bills. This should not have to wait until the next election.
Unfortunately, it will have to. So, in the spirit of lighting a candle rather than cursing the darkness, I will point you to three Pennsylvania congressional candidates who will have an outsized impact on the Democrats' ability to attack the problem of rising costs by winning the 2026 midterms. Check out their websites, where you can sign up and/or donate:
* [Bob Harvie ](https://substack.com/redirect/c0458940-63c5-407c-be9e-a222d0401447?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) is challenging incumbent Republican Brian Fitzpatrick in Pennsylvania's first Congressional district, in what is considered one of the swingiest counties in America (Bucks County in suburban Philadelphia). Bob is already an elected county commissioner there, and highly respected. He's the best candidate we've had for this seat in years.
* Like Bob, [Paige Cognetti](https://substack.com/redirect/ff89c688-d7b4-4efc-97ef-e1dbda8ab9ae?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) is a highly respected local elected. She's the mayor of Scranton, and she's also young, intelligent, and talented. She's running against the guy who promised not to trade stocks, but keeps making stock trades while in Congress and has a secret [helicopter](https://substack.com/redirect/428ce2cc-4447-42b4-bf31-4085bc80d570?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg). This is an incredible opportunity.
* [Janelle Stelson](https://substack.com/redirect/99bd5e6c-c8a4-4a7c-9fbe-ad9dcc4582a6?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) ran a great race against Scott Perry in Central Pennsylvania last time, and she significantly over performed the Democratic ticket. The turnout will be better for her and worse for Perry this time, and she can definitely win this with enough support.

Many of the people impacted by the cost increases I wrote about above will never be able to contribute to these campaigns, or have enough time off to participate in them. If you are able, please remember that you can make a difference for a lot of people by getting involved. We're all in it together.

| | For more than two decades, I have made it a priority to hear directly from veterans in Northwest Washington. These conversations are invaluable to understanding both the progress we have made and the work that remains to ensure our nation fulfills its promises to those who served. This fall, I hosted roundtables in Everett, Bellingham, Burlington, Oak Harbor, and Lummi Nation to hear from veterans about their experiences and needs. [**The feedback from those discussions shaped my new report,****_Listening to Veterans in Northwest Washington_****, which outlines the most pressing issues facing local veterans and provides policy recommendations for Congress and the Department of Veterans Affairs (VA).**](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/119293868/582578760/1410472078?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTMvMS84NzY1OSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIzN2EwOGViYy04OWMxLWYwMTEtODE5Ni02MDQ1YmRmZThlOWMiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=iqAvRSVYtmYGBQnfauZiQHSbRLmEhObC1vvt5sUNr8Y=&emci=1c167c81-17c0-f011-8196-6045bdfe8e9c&emdi=37a08ebc-89c1-f011-8196-6045bdfe8e9c&ceid=9494239) [Read the Report](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/119293869/582578761/1410472078?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTMvMS84NzY1OSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIzN2EwOGViYy04OWMxLWYwMTEtODE5Ni02MDQ1YmRmZThlOWMiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=iqAvRSVYtmYGBQnfauZiQHSbRLmEhObC1vvt5sUNr8Y=&emci=1c167c81-17c0-f011-8196-6045bdfe8e9c&emdi=37a08ebc-89c1-f011-8196-6045bdfe8e9c&ceid=9494239) **Veterans in our community have made clear that our nation's commitment must go beyond words and ceremonies. We must guarantee access to quality health care, affordable housing, education, and good jobs for every veteran.** Unfortunately, VA leadership did not attend this year's roundtables, missing an important opportunity to hear directly from veterans. I have sent a letter to VA Secretary Doug Collins urging stronger engagement with our local veteran community. **Since the passage of the Honoring our PACT Act in 2022, 37% more veterans are receiving care through the VA. Yet instead of meeting this increased demand with more staff, the Trump administration has cut approximately 30,000 VA employees, including nurses, doctors, and social workers.** These cuts threaten the quality and timeliness of care veterans deserve. I will continue fighting in Congress to oppose these harmful cuts and to invest in the people and resources that serve veterans every day. **Together, we can ensure that every veteran in Northwest Washington receives the care, benefits, and respect they have earned.** Thank you for your continued support. More soon, _Rick_ |

clean_body: We must guarantee access to quality health care, affordable housing, education, and good jobs for every veteran. | | | | For more than two decades, I have made it a priority to hear directly from veterans in Northwest Washington. These conversations are invaluable to understanding both the progress we have made and the work that remains to ensure our nation fulfills its promises to those who served. This fall, I hosted roundtables in Everett, Bellingham, Burlington, Oak Harbor, and Lummi Nation to hear from veterans about their experiences and needs. Veterans in our community have made clear that our nation's commitment must go beyond words and ceremonies. We must guarantee access to quality health care, affordable housing, education, and good jobs for every veteran. Unfortunately, VA leadership did not attend this year's roundtables, missing an important opportunity to hear directly from veterans. I have sent a letter to VA Secretary Doug Collins urging stronger engagement with our local veteran community. Since the passage of the Honoring our PACT Act in 2022, 37% more veterans are receiving care through the VA. Yet instead of meeting this increased demand with more staff, the Trump administration has cut approximately 30,000 VA employees, including nurses, doctors, and social workers. These cuts threaten the quality and timeliness of care veterans deserve. I will continue fighting in Congress to oppose these harmful cuts and to invest in the people and resources that serve veterans every day. Together, we can ensure that every veteran in Northwest Washington receives the care, benefits, and respect they have earned. Thank you for your continued support. body:
I wanted you to hear this directly from me | | | Hi, Friend, it’s Sherrod. I wanted to reach out personally and share some incredible news: **A brand-new poll shows me leading my opponent Jon Husted – 49% to 48%.** First, I want to say _thank you_. I got back in the fight to take on a rigged system that benefits the wealthy and well-connected, while working people pay the price. And this early momentum is a strong sign that our people-powered campaign is resonating with Ohioans. But here's the problem: The wealthy donors, the corporate special interests – they’re all panicking after seeing this poll. You probably didn’t wake up thinking you’d make a donation to GIFFORDS...
#

Friend,
When you woke up this morning, you probably didn’t think you’d be making your first online contribution to GIFFORDS PAC.
But today we’re asking you if you can do just that.
**If you know already that you’re able to give today, you can use this link to make a contribution:**
**[https://go.giffords.org/go/November2025](https://go.giffords.org/go/14457?c0=giffords-em-q42025.UDsFRy&refcode=em251114-1-b&t=1&akid=11034%2E3935704%2ERmAVja)**
If you need a little more explanation as to why your contribution today is so important, allow us to give you some reasons.
Tomorrow, we’re facing our November mid-quarter fundraising deadline. All of our fundraising deadlines are crucial, but this mid-quarter deadline is especially important. That’s because it marks the halfway point from our Q4 fundraising deadline. Our gun lobby adversaries will be scouring our numbers for any signs of weakness. After the fall elections, we really need your support to have a strong showing.
The gun lobby may be losing some of their influence, but their hold on many extreme politicians will not go away overnight.
Many far-right politicians refuse to act on gun violence out of fear of backlash from the gun lobby. But that fear is nothing in comparison to what a child feels when a shooter enters their school. It’s nothing in comparison to what a parent who is praying to be reunited with their child after a mass shooting must feel.
This is unacceptable. Apathy is not an option.
We have to raise a lot to help elect new leaders and beat the NRA’s hold on Congress. Our preparations to elect gun safety champions at all levels of government are well underway. That’s why our fundraising goals—especially at deadlines like the one we’re facing tomorrow—are so critical.
We know you may not have woken up today thinking you’d contribute $3 to GIFFORDS PAC. But we hope now we’ve convinced you that today is the perfect day to do so.
[**So please, use this link to make a contribution of $3 to GIFFORDS PAC before our mid-quarter fundraising deadline passes tomorrow.**](https://go.giffords.org/go/14457?c0=giffords-em-q42025.UDsFRy&refcode=em251114-1-b&t=2&akid=11034%2E3935704%2ERmAVja)

body:
The lawsuit the Supreme Court agreed to hear isn't about fairness. It's not about so-called "election integrity," because millions of taxpayers' dollars have been wasted on state investigations looking for mail-in ballot fraud that simply does not exist.
This lawsuit is a political ploy to suppress legitimate mail-in ballots that are postmarked by Election Day and potentially delayed by the U.S. Postal Service. This lawsuit targets our fellow citizens who have done nothing wrong and might have their vote suppressed through delays out of their control. And it's all because the political party that brought the lawsuit knows that those delayed ballots are more likely to have been cast by voters for the other party and not themselves.
We cannot let anyone get away with such a cynical attempt at hidden voter suppression, no matter who controls the Supreme Court. RUSH $25 or more right now to help us spread the word about this lawsuit and defend the right to vote across the country >> [http://secure.actblue.com/donate/ifvap-power?refcode=111425_2&amount=25]
Voter Action Project [https://voteractionproject.org/]
DemDocket: SCOTUS to Hear GOP Lawsuit That Could Radically Restrict Mail Voting [http://secure.actblue.com/donate/ifvap-power?refcode=111425_2&amount=25]
Team: Mail-in ballots are under attack again.
This week, the Supreme Court agreed to hear arguments in RNC v. Wetzel, a lawsuit challenging Mississippi’s law allowing a five-day grace period for late-arriving ballots mailed by Election Day. In simpler terms, it's a case about whether your vote will count if you mail it on or before Election Day, but your ballot arrives after Election Day.
It's clear why a political party -- in this case, the Republican National Committee (RNC) -- is claiming that states must reject ballots that arrive after Election Day. Doing so would potentially disenfranchise a large number of voters, restricting the number of participants in an election. And the data is clear, over the last several election cycles, Republicans have been outnumbered in the use of mail-in ballots.
The RNC is making a blunt decision that their ability to win elections matters more than your vote. It's a cynical attempt to stay in power by suppressing ballots that are delivered late by the postal service. It's the kind of partisan work that shows they'd rather believe in their own power and control than the principles of democracy, of a country where all our votes should count, regardless of party.
Team: We cannot allow blatant partisanship to overrule our right to vote. Help make every mail-in ballot count in Mississippi and beyond with $25 or whatever you can today to make every voice heard in our elections >> [http://secure.actblue.com/donate/ifvap-power?refcode=111425_2&amount=25]

Our position is clear: If your ballot was postmarked by Election Day, it should count.
This shouldn't be a partisan question. No political party -- Democrat, Republican, Green, Working Families, Libertarian, Reform, Conservative -- should be against voting. No party in our democracy should want to restrict the fundamental right of our fellow citizens to make their voice heard through voting.
But now we're facing a case where the Supreme Court’s decision could strike down or uphold laws in 16 states (and Washington D.C.) allowing late-arriving ballots postmarked on or before Election Day to be counted if they arrive within a set grace period.
How do we know what is at stake? Data from the 2024 Massachusetts elections shows that their three-day grace period for ballots to arrive after Election Day resulted in a 60% drop in rejected ballots as compared to no grace period. That means thousands of votes still counted, more than 1.5% of the total vote count. In a close election, that 1.5% could easily mean the difference between winning and losing.
Our fundamental right to vote should matter so much more than a partisan desperation to win. Chip in $25 or whatever you can to help us defend the use of mail-in ballots and make every vote count in elections nationwide >> [http://secure.actblue.com/donate/ifvap-power?refcode=111425_2&amount=25]

Integrity First Voter Action Project is dedicated to expanding ballot access and increasing voter participation across the country.
Since the Supreme Court gutted key provisions in the Voting Rights Act, extreme politicians have taken advantage to pass harsh laws that restrict access to the ballot box. name: Tobias Read
subject: Add your name: Call on Christy McCormick to resign
body:
https://secure.actblue.com/donate/read-em-24?refcode=251114-mccormick-pet-rs [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/read-em-24?refcode=251114-mccormick-pet-rs]
Hi, it’s Oregon Secretary of State, Tobias Read.
I don’t say this lightly — what we’re witnessing is a betrayal of the public trust.
Recently, Christy McCormick, a sitting federal election official, went on stage at a Trump-aligned event and claimed that Democrats “need the votes of illegal citizens” to win elections:
https://secure.actblue.com/donate/read-em-24?refcode=251114-mccormick-pet-rs [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/read-em-24?refcode=251114-mccormick-pet-rs]
That is a dangerous lie — one that undermines faith in our democracy and fans the flames of paranoia.
These are not the words of a nonpartisan public servant. They’re the words of a conspiracy theorist with a federal platform. And every day she remains in office, she damages public confidence in the elections that hold this country together.
That’s why I’m calling on Americans everywhere — Democrats, Republicans, and independents alike — to join me in demanding accountability.
Add your name to the petition calling for Commissioner McCormick’s resignation immediately: [https://secure.ngpvan.com/CL-OwXrTU0m-UjKeLBwZXg2]
ADD YOUR NAME [https://secure.ngpvan.com/CL-OwXrTU0m-UjKeLBwZXg2]
Simply put: It’s un-American to spread lies that sow fear and paranoia in the heart of our democracy.
Our founders built this nation on free and fair elections. Every generation since has been asked to defend democracy in its own way. For us, that means standing up to the lies that corrode trust in free and fair elections.
If we stay silent now, this kind of rot spreads — from the edges of the fever swamp straight into the heart of our government.
Commissioner McCormick’s false claims dishonor our democracy. She betrayed the trust of the people she was meant to serve. She must resign or be removed immediately. Let’s make our voices heard. Let’s prove that Americans still stand for truth, decency, and democracy.
Right now, add your name to demand Christy McCormick’s resignation: [https://secure.ngpvan.com/CL-OwXrTU0m-UjKeLBwZXg2]
Thank you for standing up for democracy.
Tobias Read

Trump’s Department of Justice says he has “broad unreviewable powers.” | |
---
Peter, **Trump is running to the Supreme Court for cover again—this time in an attempt to get permission to flood America’s cities with National Guard troops.** After Trump attempted to deploy troops in Chicago earlier this year, a district court judge stepped in to stop him. Now, the case has made it to the Supreme Court, and the justices have asked Trump to plead his case before they rule. **His Department of Justice has now answered their request, arguing that Trump has “broad unreviewable powers” to militarize our cities.** They want permission to send troops to any city, any time, for any reason. This is one of Trump’s most clearly authoritarian moves yet. And he knows the MAGA justices he installed on the Court are likely to give him a blank check. [**But the Constitution doesn’t belong to wannabe dictators—it belongs to We the People. Add your name today! Tell the Supreme Court: Don’t give Trump a blank check to occupy cities.**](https://click.actionnetwork.org/ss/c/u001.qUXRBnqZ7T8nxbpAcIVwoUsWLkUMWlo_0JmZttSlm39xlBV8K-h1SPh5Rb04hGqQSppTR2K2TLKBv7L84jlhD8_niZxUc0G_DczrK6akg6xCClNFlVUC-4Rif7Se_PccY6AzjAEahMfC1iZvEI43sSYMfY689JK7VZeGr7FT32WZHIhccvs_MtTQx2X2lXFBg3OoyPLjUZ9-9W3FDx8uwzR_pCrz_ZB7My_ZS-Rlsfnym6nRT1U-JDLdDlZsKU19HxMV89mrAe8PY8eqMuqILsTrKujyFQoqjONfoLPy-3uWTC8uKTDgiAUbpGF-u2MsBHSI_o5edi16bJDWVJPtA2GhSOWWbubg2rs9Xr08BPE/4ll/Ogvlqa3kQ_CTabrDdUiGqg/h0/h001.G0M9wnJ6So-Jf2NIXKOniwWsX6MQAeNmlGn5gOwtG_I) The law says the president may only deploy National Guard troops when facing foreign invasion, rebellion, or, when law can’t be kept with “regular forces.” The Court wants this case to be about what “regular forces” means, so they can get away with giving him the green light. **But Trump’s Solicitor General is taking it even further, arguing that the Court has no right to review his deployment activities at all.** In his filing, he says Trump’s ability to deploy troops under any circumstances is “not judicially reviewable at all,” and that the justices should be “extremely deferential.” **Trump’s attempt to send troops into Chicago is a clear attempt to suppress dissent and silence free speech.** And he’s trying to strong arm his already supportive Supreme Court into giving him judicial cover. After Trump attempted to deploy troops in Chicago earlier this year, a district court judge stepped in to stop him. Now, the case has made it to the Supreme Court, and the justices have asked Trump to plead his case before they rule. His Department of Justice has now answered their request, arguing that Trump has “broad unreviewable powers” to militarize our cities. They want permission to send troops to any city, any time, for any reason. This is one of Trump’s most clearly authoritarian moves yet. And he knows the MAGA justices he installed on the Court are likely to give him a blank check. The law says the president may only deploy National Guard troops when facing foreign invasion, rebellion, or, when law can’t be kept with “regular forces.” The Court wants this case to be about what “regular forces” means, so they can get away with giving him the green light. But Trump’s Solicitor General is taking it even further, arguing that the Court has no right to review his deployment activities at all. In his filing, he says Trump’s ability to deploy troops under any circumstances is “not judicially reviewable at all,” and that the justices should be “extremely deferential.” Trump’s attempt to send troops into Chicago is a clear attempt to suppress dissent and silence free speech. And he’s trying to strong arm his already supportive Supreme Court into giving him judicial cover. Thank you for fighting authoritarianism, Morgan Stahr United for Democracy Paid for by United for Democracy. | | Sent via . Derek — There is no limit to what Donald Trump is willing to do to punish his enemies.
He used the Department of Justice to go after former FBI director James Comey and New York Attorney General Letitia James, who brought fraud charges against him.
Trump ordered the Justice Department to go after me and other political opponents for having impeached him and having served on the January 6th Committee.
Derek, we don’t know what he will do next. But here’s what we do know: There’s no agenda more important to Donald Trump than retribution.
He feeds conspiracy theories to his followers.
Makes their targets more vulnerable.
Then goes after them by name, unleashing the forces of his administration to try to bring them down.
**This is a dark road. And we have a President who is all too willing to drive us down it.** They hope to silence their critics and give themselves carte blanche to rip off the country.
But guess what: I will never be intimidated or deterred. Not by the likes of these crooks.

Peter,
The results from last week’s election have finally settled in.
Voters took to the polls to defend democracy. They pushed for leaders to protect voting rights and our fundamental freedoms. And they demanded fairness and opposed blatant map manipulation to ensure our elections truly represent the will of the people.
As we reflect on the progress made, we can’t lose focus on the work ahead to strengthen and protect our democracy.
From empowering voters to speak out against extreme, racial gerrymanders to combating anti-democracy legislation in state legislatures, our work to ensure that the American people can participate in a democracy that’s truly and fairly representative is happening all around us. And it’s a marathon, not a sprint.
These fights will have far-reaching implications for years, maybe decades, to come. And as we’ve all been reminded all year long, there are truly no off-years when it comes to gerrymandering.
That’s why we can’t afford to let up. Not while anti-democracy forces are working to diminish the voting power of communities of color in Texas. Not while Louisiana’s fair map is on the line in a Supreme Court case that threatens the Voting Rights Act.
The fair maps movement requires sustained investment to ensure we can keep up our efforts, pushing back against map manipulation right now, and remaining ready to respond to threats against our democracy at a moment’s notice.

clean_body: Pivoting faster than ever before | = | It’s time to step back and take stock of where we are: We had hoped to spend 2025 already hard at work in key swing districts, organizing early and laying the groundwork necessary to flip these seats from red to blue. But Donald Trump’s attempts to rig the 2026 election before a single vote was cast derailed our efforts. California had to respond to neutralize the effects of Texas eliminating 5 Democratic districts, which resulted in our campaign and big win passing Proposition 50 to draw new district lines. = = The truth is, we had no choice but to focus on passing Proposition 50 to defend democracy in all 50 states. Donald Trump ordered Texas and other red states to eliminate blue seats because Republicans “deserved” them. Texas Republicans followed his orders immediately, taking the unprecedented step of redrawing their congressional districts mid-decade. Governor Newsom immediately responded, putting together a plan that kept voters — not MAGA politicians — in charge of our elections. And the California Democratic Party joined the effort, tirelessly helping lead organizing across the state.And we won. But that’s only the first step. Now, on a tighter time crunch than ever before, we need to deploy organizing resources to the new swing seats all across the state. The plans we made earlier this year need to be totally redone, and we need to draw up new proposals for regional offices, organizer recruitment, literature development, and so much more. = = = = = = Thank you so much, \- The California Democratic Party | | = Our Democratic leaders are working hard to make California a better place to live. **➤➤ BREAKING: Supreme Court takes up case that could gut vote-by-mail** **[](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/119299227/582596965/-248329304?refcode=em-11.14.25-all-a&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzAvMS84OTkxNCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI5YjEwOTliZC05NWMxLWYwMTEtODE5Ni02MDQ1YmRmZThlOWMiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=24jOXwrdj00LgIrAu6Mk1iOO87KnFa6fLOqW5t0hPEk=)**
* * *
Friend, Did you see this? The Supreme Court just agreed to take up two explosive cases about mail-in voting, including one that could allow states to **toss out legal ballots simply because they arrive a few days late** , even if they’re postmarked on time. This is exactly the kind of voter suppression Trump and his allies have been demanding, a way to make it harder for everyday Americans to vote by mail, especially in close races. subject: So long as there is air in my lungs

body:
The Republican budget passed the House.
#
This week, the Republican budget passed the House.
_**But NOT with my vote.**_
Donald Trump and Congressional Republicans raided your healthcare and used that money as a piggy bank to reward their donors with massive tax breaks.
This Republican budget continues down a path of cutting care.
To add insult to injury, tucked inside their budget were _personal payoffs of $1 million_ to eight GOP senators who were wrapped up in the investigation into January 6 — an attack where hundreds, if not thousands, of crimes were committed against our Capitol, our country, and our democracy.
**I won’t give my vote to a Republican agenda built on cruelty and corruption. That’s exactly what this budget was, and that’s why I voted no.**
I promise you this:
**So long as there is air in my lungs, I will fight every single day for healthcare for all, against corruption in our government, and for a democracy that belongs to all of us.**
But I can’t do this alone.
[**So if you’re with me, I’m asking you to chip in $5 or anything you can today. Every donation sends a powerful message that we’re coming to reclaim the House, put a check on Donald Trump, and stop Republicans’ cruelty.**](https://act.sarahmcbride.com/go/1184?c0=mcb-em-20251114-1.DHRerl&refcode=em20251114-2503&amount=5&t=1&akid=2503%2E21716%2Egc_HUf)

**HB 8002 - A Return of Housing to Hartford:**
HB 8002 imposes state domination and pre-emption of local zoning under the delusion that towns have a say in the destination of their community development.
**Towns have three ways to comply with this legislation**
1.Towns can sign contracts with the Connecticut Municipal Development Authority and develop plans to increase housing in downtowns or near train and bus stations. _**The authority was established in 2019, funded in 2024, and started work earlier this year.**_
2\. They can also opt to participate in what's known as [Work, Live, Ride](https://substack.com/redirect/6ad27d0a-11c3-449a-8c4d-30e11ca23702?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), which pushes towns to allow more housing density near train and bus rapid transit stations. It's a concept more broadly known as transit-oriented development that has grown more popular nationwide over recent years.** - Yes - Bus Stations count**
3\. The bill also says towns can create housing growth plans by working with their regional**** councils of government or on their own. Regional**** councils of government will conduct housing needs assessments.
_**If towns do not create these plans, they are not eligible for temporary pauses from being sued by developers whose affordable housing plans are denied under state statute 8-30g.**_
HB 8002 is the next step in the removal of the right of residents of a particular town or city to self govern. **This is putting the 8-30g Housing on Steroids.**
**WHAT THESE PLANS MEAN?**
All of these plans require the towns to give up their autonomy and control to a larger entity. The result is the replacement of town government with regional government. This is exactly what happens in New York State where you have County governments which then exert considerable control of local government. This is done through an elected county governing board and County Executive and county bureaucracy. This is one of the many reasons that real estate taxes are higher in New York.
**They claim this is an Opt-in Policy but it 's a Coercive Opt-In at the expense of future infrastructure and other funds **
**WHAT IS TRANSIT ORIENTED DEVELOPMENT**(TOD)?
Definition and Rationale
TOD is the concept of dense development around transit stations and transit corridors in a mixed-use and walkable neighborhood with everything you need from commercial stores to supermarkets and no need to go anywhere to get what you need within walking distance (which is the preferred mode of transportation). TODs are based on the premise that everything within walking distance will reduce congestion, improve air quality, and reduce carbon emissions. Most global cities suffer from traffic congestion and these TODs reduce auto trips by increasing the availability of goods and services within easy walking or biking range of a station and the push is to make it the global standard for healthy city growth.
**When and Where do TODs Work?**
TODs can work for cities with a transit hub with a large commercial buildings where TOD residents can , live, walk to work and shop. In Fairfield County, the biggest city and one most likely to benefit from TOD is Stamford. It is already dense with commercial office buildings, a bus transit hub and dense apartment buildings. However, its infrastructure for roads is challenging and the Harbor Point Developments and others demonstrate that there is not enough roadway it makes no sense in many of our towns. For example the Cos Cob and Riverside train stations in Greenwich are in close proximity to residential housing and lack any commercial development. This is true for many of the train stations in Fairfield County.
Could it work in Bridgeport, Norwalk, New Haven, Waterbury, Hartford? Maybe
See Stamford Video
[](https://substack.com/redirect/4deb6df9-e88d-4692-b6c7-858dc73984e0?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
**WHERE TODs DON 'T WORK?**
Simply Putting apartment buildings, under a TOD, strategy next to a train station which is nothing more than a station and a parking lot with no access to jobs or shopping does not meet the objectives of TOD. This is like most of the Metro North Train Stations like Cos Cob and Riverside and all train station stops on the New Canaan and Danbury Spur Lines.
**See Riverside - TOD Does Not work here**
[](https://substack.com/redirect/89c5bb71-5b27-4a3f-8473-37958b773292?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
One size fits all state wide legislation does not work and should not be passed.
**Commercial-to-Residential Conversion**
HB 8002 keeps the as-of right ability to build or repurpose in commercial zones.
Not every commercial zone or commercial building is right for residential conversion. Building an apartment building next to a Junk Yard would be permissible. Downtown commercial zones including the one and two story shops seen on main streets of towns could be torn down and replaced with apartment buildings**as of right and circumventing local Planning & Zoning Boards**.
**Local Charm Eliminated**
With commercial conversions, the charm and character that attracted residents to live and shop will disappear. _**The entire Post Road could become one long string of apartment buildings**_. The main shopping streets of Darien, Greenwich, Fairfield, New Canaan, Southport and Westport could all be replaced with multi-story and even high rise apartment buildings with no right of any of these towns to object.
_**What About Parking?**_
_**One of the big criticisms of the previous HB 5002 is that it did not require Off-Street Parking. Parking doesn 't have to be taken into consideration for apartment buildings with less than 16 units. As most of us know, there isn't enough parking on-street so this is a recipe for disaster as people still have cars in a TOD Utopia as most CT Residents do not work where they live and commute. TOD only really works for commuters to NYC but that still does not eliminate the need to have a car.**_
**That is why Stamford is becoming the 6 th Boro of New York City as an express train is shorter than most commutes from Brooklyn or Queens**
The Passing of this flawed bill in haste which will change what attracted to Connecticut in the first place will only help drive more taxpayers elsewhere.
**The legislation is an attempt to address the two issues of a housing shortage and affordability. However this is the wrong solution. It is about creating rental housing not owned housing.**
**REAL HOUSING SOLUTIONS**
In previous articles we proposed a 21st Century version of the Homestead Act which would allow for the creation of affordable owned housing. When a homeowner sells their house and moves they leave with a check. When a renter leaves their apartment they leave with nothing.
Middle class wealth is mostly acquired through appreciated home values and pension plans that are often subsidized by the employer. Taking away home ownership is a way to increase rather than reduce wealth disparity.
TAKE ACTION TODAY AND EMAIL LAMONT TO VETO
SAMPLE EMAIL TO GOVERNOR LAMONT at**governor.lamont@ct.gov**
_**I am writing to express my opposition to considering housing and zoning issues at the special legislative session that may be held Nov 12- 14. Convening a special session to address zoning and housing issues risks rushing intricate policies without the transparency, public input, or careful deliberation that our state residents and municipalities deserve on these matters. I implore you to prioritize the integrity of the legislative process by reserving these critical issues for the 2026 regular session.**_
_**Special sessions, by their very design, sacrifice the democratic process for speed. We 've seen this in recent years where bills on motor vehicle taxes and the Aquarion sale were expedited by using emergency certification, thereby bypassing public hearings and leaving residents and town officials confused and unaware of the last-minute provisions. Housing and zoning policies are far too consequential to suffer the same fate. A rushed special session will alienate constituents and produce flawed policies. Specifically, a special session's compressed timeline cannot accommodate the robust public hearings, expert testimony, or data-driven analysis required to get this right. These matters demand open debate and not closed-door decisions.**_
_**The 2026 regular session, just months away, offers a better path. It provides the time and the structure to engage residents, municipal leaders, and housing experts in crafting solutions that thoughtfully considers constituent input. Connecticut 's values should consist of transparency, collaboration, and respect for every voice. Please, do not let haste undermine our shared vision for a thriving Connecticut.**_
_**Sincerely, Connecticut Resident**_

subject: The mistake I made.

body:
#
You know, I made a mistake early on:
From all the movies that we see growing up about heroes and villains, I thought that fascist takeover attempts were going to be architected by evil _geniuses._
I was not expecting how unearned, nepotistic, mediocre, and just dumb so many of the people architecting this were going to be and it works because of brute force.
You can do anything through brute force, but it's not sophisticated and it does not merit our intellectual respect.
**That's my thought of the day.**
And even to that, that's why the right says: “you were a bartender, you were a bartender” to kind of project their insecurities onto me, but, I did something. I ran for Congress and won because of the incredible support from my neighbors.
Republicans want us to resign ourselves to cynicism but giving up is a privilege we can’t afford. Through solidarity we can make a new world, a better country, where our work has dignity and our lives have respect.
I can’t do this work without you — the grassroots supporters who have had my back every step of the way. I don't curry favor with billionaires or host exclusive fundraising events. This campaign's average donation floats around $17-20.
Together, we’ve built a movement that won’t back down. Thank you for being a part of it.
[Help us continue the fight with a grassroots contribution today.](https://act.ocasiocortez.com/go/14659?c0=aoc-email-20251114.ayp5u3&refcode=em20251114-10209-P_FND_EGR_GRM&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1&akid=10209%2E2526796%2EMfkZde)

In solidarity,
Alexandria

| | They're not even trying to hide it. The Trump Regime and its allies have a plan to end free and fair elections — it’s staring us all in the face. Here’s how it goes: **Rig the maps:** Conservative lawmakers have already rigged the political maps in Texas, North Carolina, and Missouri. It’s a portrait of an oligarchic elite laughing at the rest of us while we pick up the tab. | | | | | == | Peter, When Marie Antoinette uttered her infamous words--"Let them eat cake"--it became the symbol of an out-of-touch ruling class watching people starve while they dined in luxury. Two centuries later, Donald Trump is giving us a modern version: "Let them eat ballroom" | | | == | | | == | | == | While federal workers go without paychecks, and millions of families brace for delayed or slashed SNAP benefits, Trump is obsessed with ballroom renovations, gold-plated decor, and Great Gatsby-themed Halloween parties at Mar-a-Lago. All while his shutdown blocks Democrats' efforts to extend healthcare subsidies -- letting premiums skyrocket by hundreds, and even thousands, of dollars a month for working families. This isn't governing. It's mockery. It's a portrait of an oligarchic elite laughing at the rest of us while we pick up the tab. And our community is literally picking up the tab, because we refuse to let our neighbors starve while the oligarchs feast. My campaign office is now a drop-off hub for food and essentials for families hit by the shutdown. After a decade volunteering with local food pantries and leading service projects, I know this: when the government fails, it's everyday people -- not the powerful -- who step up. I'm running for Congress because I refuse to accept that this is the best we can do. My campaign is about restoring a government that serves working people, not the wealthy few. | **About the Republican Party of Florida**
* * *
The Republican Party of Florida will promote the principles upon which our nation and our state were founded: freedom, liberty, personal responsibility, and accountability.

body:
[ https://act.abdulformichigan.com/go/30?refcode=&t=1001&akid=1293%2E251025%2EAYmPVA ]Abdul for US Senate [ https://act.abdulformichigan.com/go/30?refcode=&t=1002&akid=1293%2E251025%2EAYmPVA ]Abdul for US Senate

Hey friends, Abdul here.

Republican Mike Rogers just launched his first digital ad in Michigan’s
battleground Senate race.

There’s a lot to unpack here.

Let’s start with the creepy actor family that looks like they were forced
to sit upright on a couch by Mike Rogers’ video team...

[ A ]A GIF from Mike Rogers' ad, which shows a family looking uncomfortable

And then there’s the lovely shots of me where I look like Storm from
X-Men, ushering a storm cloud into the Capitol building...

[ A ]A screenshot from the ad, showing Abdul in front of a storm around the
Capitol

I found the ad very interesting. Because what does Mike Rogers choose to
start his campaign with? A defense of his disastrous support for the
extremely unpopular Big Ugly Bill that Trump signed into law.

As a reminder, this is the bill that:

* Cut healthcare for 15 million, and Medicare by $500 billion
* Added $4 trillion to the deficit
* Eliminated 760,000 manufacturing and energy jobs
* Could force as many as 300 rural hospitals to close

They did all that to give trillions of dollars in tax breaks to
billionaires.

Mike Rogers knows this was really unpopular. He wants to cover himself by
running dishonest ads saying I want to “raise your taxes.” And if we don’t
have a strong counter-message in this election, Mike Rogers will walk
right into the U.S. Senate and vote for even more giveaways to
billionaires.

Peter, I don’t
think we can win this critical Senate seat by just banking on voters
turning out for a “blue no matter who” candidate that stands for nothing.

We win this Senate seat by driving historic turnout and excitement around
a very simple message that cuts through all the lies:

* Money OUT of politics
* Money IN your pocket
* Medicare for ALL

I’m the only Democrat in this primary driving that message home. If people
like you, reading emails like this, decide to make a donation or sign up
to volunteer, we can bring that message to the general election and win.
If not, we lose. And there’s a chance that Republicans keep this Senate
seat in a close election.

[ https://act.abdulformichigan.com/go/507?c0=em-ms-aes-20251114-1-ak.hSGPzV&amount=10&refcode=em20251114-1291&t=1004&akid=1293%2E251025%2EAYmPVA ]Peter, will
you please donate $10 today to ensure Democrats have a clear
message heading into Michigan’s critical Senate race? Whether you can
donate that amount, or more or less, doesn’t particularly matter to me
right now. What matters is that we have maximum participation in our
campaign.

[ https://act.abdulformichigan.com/go/507?c0=em-ms-aes-20251114-1-ak.hSGPzV&amount=10&refcode=em20251114-1291&t=1023&akid=1293%2E251025%2EAYmPVA ]Donate $10 ››

Some people will be able to give more, and I’m grateful for that. Some
people can only chip in a few bucks, and I’m grateful for that, too. Some
people can’t give at all, but can spend a few hours volunteering.

Each of us is going to have to do what we’re capable of to win this race.
The stakes are very, very high.

If we don’t win the primary, and Democrats push out yet another candidate
with a muddled message, it’s not just our campaign that’s in trouble. It’s
our country. Because Mike Rogers is a lot of things... but he’s someone we’d
be foolish to underestimate. His folks will run ads like this one
relentlessly, lying about his record and trying to confuse voters about
the Democrats.

Only the Democrat with a clear message can win.

* Money OUT of politics
* Money IN your pocket
* Medicare for ALL

[ https://act.abdulformichigan.com/go/507?c0=em-ms-aes-20251114-1-ak.hSGPzV&amount=10&refcode=em20251114-1291&t=1024&akid=1293%2E251025%2EAYmPVA ]If you’re with us, please let me know right now. Give
$10 or whatever you can to this email to say, “Yes, a clear
message wins in 2026.”

Thank you from the bottom of my heart for everything you’ve done so far.

In solidarity,

Abdul

Peter,

## Life-Advice-Giving Seniors Go Viral
[A group of seniors](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJykkLGO4yAURb8Gd0TwwM6moNiGLttuaRH8nsMGQwRvk_HfjzzzCVNeXeno3vP3Ol9Dyqmsf8KGjlaamepc8N0zMmObO5ZUW1_rK7WQtdI7hlbz0mdQMEqtpbbzElLeZzssjhABzYBOnyejR6tHM9ydMgrgvBCO9mbM5UZEZEGp0Y7wy6hpSO6gaa0taAVGneKk0I6TAsIY6RKEVbgkru30r6bCd6S81xe2U6zbkN2d-dmF-S3AC_Blf9bORyXAH2ABXmsBXk0C_P8uj38CPKcH18cRP1iuWGQl2Tm0LmPdUlkltbrJskf5bUFGLIxNgB-aW57vlHPq01lYtW4h5a8t_GOJLwefAQAA__8N4oYJ) from RiverSpring Living in the Bronx has become an unlikely social media hit, racking up nearly 2 million followers across TikTok and Instagram with life advice, humor, and pop culture commentary. Dubbed the “Old Friend Club,” the eight-member crew, ages 72 to 105, was launched by media company Pubity to spotlight aging with purpose and personality. [See their Instagram page here](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJyk0LFu6yAUxvGnwVssDmA7HhjuVWR1Sat26YiIOdinwmABipu3r9JX6P7T90n_z6u5WgoUl1e7ofaLN9UnE_EoAWvFbApGSrks6U7ZBuDwQJtTcMUILroTwAmUcZbCw6jGaY8oUDaoYegldAo62ayao-NuPM8jqAHVzQqJ_dyNt7O3g4BBNqSfawCgBHAheTv3HFXXc-Fxnv1omeLoqKbcfiWKdUUfHumOuZ3T1gS91roXJv8xMTExHcfRUizVLtluT8HEtDMxXd7njwJIL_btCeW0BiYvGJno7bYz-Z-2xVB0-M3kpWuydvtBIVDpB6b4slkKv3_1z6HuWvwEAAD__3Lqe-U). After crashing and burning in his presidential run, Vivek Ramaswamy — the Trump-endorsed billionaire who built his brand on MAGA extremism — is now running for governor of Ohio.

And he's not just dipping his toes in: he's pledging $30 million of his own money to buy this election, flying around the state on his private jet, and bragging about his ties to Trump at every campaign stop.

This is the same guy who pushed conspiracy theories, defended Trump at every turn, and even worked on the "DOGE" project with Elon Musk before leaving Trump's orbit to plot his next political stunt. He thrives on chaos, self-promotion, and attention — not actually helping the people he claims to represent.

This race will be tough. But we just endorsed the candidate who can beat him: public health champion **Dr. Amy Acton.**

A new poll shows Amy leading by one point. In a state Trump won by eight points in 2024, this poll is proof that Ohioans are ready for change and that we can win this race with the right investment.

Dr. Acton is everything Vivek isn't: grounded, compassionate, and focused on helping real families, not chasing _Fox News_ headlines. But she's up against a self-funded billionaire who will stop at nothing to buy power and push his MAGA ideology into the governor's mansion.

This is the same guy who pushed conspiracy theories, defended Trump at every turn, and even worked on the "DOGE" project with Elon Musk before leaving Trump's orbit to plot his next political stunt. name: Sherrod Brown
subject: I have to ask you
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Blue Amp Action
body:
We’re facing an uphill battle, and I need folks like you by my side to make it to the top.
| | | | |
---
| | | | |
---
| _You're getting this message because you’ve supported good causes and Democratic candidates. We need your support to continue fighting for our democracy. We love having you in our network, but if you no longer wish to hear from us, you can[unsubscribe here](https://default.salsalabs.org/T03578136-8924-4e32-95ce-5e63d21aeb4a/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9)._
---
| I know you’re likely getting a ton of emails from candidates and causes right now, Peter. But I have to ask: [Is there anything I can say to convince you to chip in $5 between my Senate campaign in Ohio and Blue Amp Action? ](https://default.salsalabs.org/Ta438d366-4c59-4b82-af8b-b47c1f2b9acd/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9) What if I told you that right after I joined this race, experts at The Cook Political Report increased our odds of winning What if I told you that CNN and The New York Times report that Ohio is “in play” – but that corporate special interests are gearing up to spend millions against me? What if I told you that misleading attack ads have already hit the airwaves – and that whether we’re able to counter these smears and reach voters with the truth depends on people like you? This grassroots, small-dollar donor movement is our best chance to flip Ohio’s Senate seat. But we’re facing an uphill battle, and I need folks like you by my side to win. [So please, split $5 or more between me and Blue Amp Action to power our campaign forward, win in Ohio, and keep up the fight for working people.](https://default.salsalabs.org/Td776bf10-d76d-4afb-a909-303042e002e9/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9)

Powered by People believes that our government should be doing more for working people.
#
When we send you these fundraising emails, we’re not just raising money to “fight back” or “resist.” We’re building toward a clear, positive vision of our future.
Powered by People believes that _our government — in Texas and DC — should be doing more to deliver for the people, not the powerful._ That means:
* Raising the minimum wage so no one has to work two or three jobs to make ends meet.
* Ensuring all Americans have the ability to see a doctor and get the care they need.
* Guaranteeing that every kid can go to world-class public schools.
* Making sure people have access to child care, paid leave, and affordable housing.
* No longer allowing gun violence to be the leading cause of death for kids.

Too many Democratic leaders only react to Trump — but reacting isn’t a strategy, and it’s not how we win the voters we need to change this country. What brings people in and turns them out to vote is a bold vision and a plan to deliver on it.
We’re on the ground having conversations with communities, hosting town halls, registering voters, and showing how to use power for the people.
But this work is only as strong as the movement behind it. Your donation builds the resources we need to reach more voters, turn them out, and finally give Texas a fighting chance.

body:
Thank you in advance for opening this email.
# [](https://act.debhaaland.com/go/133?t=1&akid=5692%2E400544%2E8bVRKU)
Hi, Deb here.
2026 is _weeks_ away, and we know that Donald Trump and Republicans are trying to flip New Mexico red.
**Just days ago, another Republican opponent entered this race, and another is rumored to be announcing _soon._ Opponents are lining up to bring the MAGA playbook to the governor’s office.**
They know just as well as we do that New Mexico’s governorship tends to flip parties every eight years, and they’re coming for this seat right on schedule. Before long, conservative super PACs and right-wing megadonors will begin pouring millions of dollars into our state and try to buy a path to victory.
That’s why it’s absolutely critical we stay on pace to reach our fundraising goals, but right now we’re not.
**[I’d be grateful for anything you can give right now. Can I count on you to step up with a donation of $5 or anything you can spare?](https://act.debhaaland.com/go/807?c0=em_ms_dh_20251114_1_midmonth.dGI_DY&amount=5&refcode=em20251114-5692&t=2&akid=5692%2E400544%2E8bVRKU)**
**[Donate $5 »](https://act.debhaaland.com/go/807?c0=em_ms_dh_20251114_1_midmonth.dGI_DY&amount=5&refcode=em20251114-5692&t=3&akid=5692%2E400544%2E8bVRKU)**
**As you know, I don’t come from wealth, and I’ve never had the means to self-fund a campaign.** What I do have is this grassroots team — tens of thousands of folks like you who believe that New Mexico needs a governor who understands what it means to struggle and who will fight fiercely for our home and our people.
The average online donation to our campaign is **$23.** It’s that steady stream of people-powered support that allows us to build support across our beautiful state. It helps us pay for critical campaign investments, distribute literature, run digital ads, and connect with voters in the places that are too often ignored.
**The reality is this: When Donald Trump and Republicans put millions into flipping this state, we won’t stand a chance unless our grassroots numbers are strong. We can’t let this happen.** That’s why I’m concerned, and it’s why I’m asking for your support today to help us reach our mid-month goal.
**[My campaign could use your help right now. Will you donate $5 or your most generous donation today to help us raise the $25,000 we need by midnight tomorrow to power our campaign forward?](https://act.debhaaland.com/go/807?c0=em_ms_dh_20251114_1_midmonth.dGI_DY&amount=5&refcode=em20251114-5692&t=4&akid=5692%2E400544%2E8bVRKU)**

Thank you again for everything you’re doing to support our campaign. I know there is no obstacle we can’t overcome if we continue standing together.
Be fierce,
Deb

name: Seth for Massachusetts
subject: Massachusetts deserves better than the status quo
body:
We set a $10,000 mid-month goal because the challenges we face can’t wait.

| |
---
Team, We set a $10,000 online fundraising goal to hit by tomorrow night, because real change doesn’t happen by accident. Seth’s running for Senate because he’s tired of watching Washington move too slowly while Massachusetts families are being priced out of their homes, waiting for better transportation options, or wondering how they’ll afford childcare or healthcare next month. The problems we’re facing aren’t unsolvable — they’re just stuck behind the same stale thinking that’s kept our politics from working for real people. Here’s what Seth stands for:

🏡 Affordable housing built near jobs and transit so families can stay rooted in their communities.
🚄 High-speed rail that connects every corner of Massachusetts and strengthens our economy.
⚕️ Healthcare that works for people, not corporations, with a strong national public option.
🧠 Mental health care that’s accessible and stigma-free.
🌍 Bold climate solutions that create good-paying jobs. That’s what it means to fight the status quo, not just to say what’s wrong, but to build something better. We’ve already proven what this campaign can do in just our first month. → End the extended and needless federalization of California National Guard troops.
→ Send our hardworking servicemembers back to their regular duty and regular lives.
→ Free Los Angeles from a completely unjustified military occupation.
The National Guard is not Trump’s Royal Guard to use as a personal, traveling police force whenever he wants, wherever he wants, for however long he wants.
As California’s Attorney General, I won’t back down from this fight — the President can’t be allowed to unlawfully infringe on Californians’ rights with impunity.

name: Wes Moore
subject: Deeply personal
body:
# [](https://act.wesmoore.com/go/8?t=1&akid=922%2E1086043%2EjsKxpS)
Peter, Trump and Republicans in Congress are putting health care at risk for thousands of Marylanders.
Unless a deal is reached in Congress many people’s health care premiums will spike, sometimes by tens of thousands of dollars, when their health care is already too expensive. **It is completely unacceptable.**
Health care is something that is very personal to me. My father died in front of me when I was three years old because he didn’t get the health care he needed.
Making health care costs skyrocket will make our country sicker, more vulnerable, and it makes no sense. Right now, we need leaders who understand how personal and how high-stakes the costs of health care are. We can’t afford political games.
**[I’m fighting for a Maryland where we leave no one behind, and one where people can afford to thrive. If you’re with me, will you chip in to our reelection campaign today?](https://act.wesmoore.com/go/417?c0=wes-em-20251114-2.DFaRNh&refcode=em-20251114-2&t=4&akid=922%2E1086043%2EjsKxpS)**

That’s not how an economy should work.

Families in Rhode Island shouldn’t have to stretch every dollar because of Trump’s tariff temper tantrums.

I’m fighting to lift the burden — to end these tariffs, to lower costs, and to make sure that the economy works for the people who actually keep it running.

# Mid-November Update from Kevin
---
| | Dear Friend and Patriot,
I hope this message finds you well! We have been very busy this past week with some big developments on our pathway to reclaim Michigan as your next Michigan Attorney General in 2026.
---
| |
On the media front, I had a [great interview with John Anthony](https://kevinformi.us3.list-manage.com/track/click?u=39782b0ca6b504d2faad7a196&id=cfe50e8a74&e=4b10910eed) this morning on Detroit's Morning Answer 92.7 FM, diving into Michigan's pressing issues. We covered my win getting MI AG Nessel's partisan lawfare dismissed in court in addition to her wasteful taxpayer spending on suing President Trump 35 times. We also spoke about election integrity by blocking non-citizen voting, backing our law enforcement heroes, leveraging AG opinions to enforce laws, and stopping sanctuary policies. [Click on the image below to listen to Kevin’s interview with John Anthony](https://kevinformi.us3.list-manage.com/track/click?u=39782b0ca6b504d2faad7a196&id=fe18be389c&e=4b10910eed).
---
[|
---](https://kevinformi.us3.list-manage.com/track/click?u=39782b0ca6b504d2faad7a196&id=2489571e55&e=4b10910eed)
| |

**Endorsement news:**
I’m pleased to announce that the following patriots have endorsed our campaign for AG, recognizing our commitment to protecting Michigan families and restoring integrity to Lansing. They have joined our coalition, lending their voice to our mission of making Michigan great again for all residents, not just some. These endorsements from key GOP party officials matter. They reflect that more people across the state see the urgency of this race and want real leadership.
* Regina (Reggie) Wilk, MIGOP State Committeewoman (11th Congressional District)
* Ronald Kokinda, MIGOP State Committeeman (13th Congressional District)
* Alyson Edwards, Sanilac County GOP Chair
* Sanilac County County GOP (County Party Endorsement)
* Austin Franzel, Lapeer County GOP Youth Vice Chairman

---
[|
---](https://kevinformi.us3.list-manage.com/track/click?u=39782b0ca6b504d2faad7a196&id=3c967ae1de&e=4b10910eed)
| |
Also, I had an absolute blast [speaking to a packed room of fired-up delegates from Michigan’s 10th Congressional District](https://kevinformi.us3.list-manage.com/track/click?u=39782b0ca6b504d2faad7a196&id=9b0711166a&e=4b10910eed) last night! These patriots are ready to reclaim our state from the radical left and sharing our campaign’s vision for restoring public safety, defending constitutional rights, and ensuring election integrity as Michigan’s next Attorney General.
---
| | | | | | | | | | [|
---](https://kevinformi.us3.list-manage.com/track/click?u=39782b0ca6b504d2faad7a196&id=536030a622&e=4b10910eed)

---](https://kevinformi.us3.list-manage.com/track/click?u=39782b0ca6b504d2faad7a196&id=446630103f&e=4b10910eed)
| |
Lastly, we had an i[ncredible gathering of patriots from across southeast Michigan in Monroe County](https://kevinformi.us3.list-manage.com/track/click?u=39782b0ca6b504d2faad7a196&id=a0e2334c74&e=4b10910eed) earlier this week. It was an honor to speak alongside former Michigan AG Mike Cox about many of the critical issues facing our state - fighting for our constitutional rights, defending our families and children, protecting consumers, and standing up against the radical left’s agenda.
---
| | | | | | | | | | [|

---](https://kevinformi.us3.list-manage.com/track/click?u=39782b0ca6b504d2faad7a196&id=d2a56bcaed&e=4b10910eed)
| | I’m looking forward to meeting with additional Republican groups later in November and December from across the state.
I’m committed to keeping you informed and welcome your feedback. As Michigan's next Attorney General, I’ll fight to uphold the rule of law, prosecute dangerous criminals, protect our Second Amendment rights, stop political prosecutions, and defend the hardworking people of this state from government overreach. [To win against the radical left's agenda, please contribute today and join the movement to take Michigan back!](https://kevinformi.us3.list-manage.com/track/click?u=39782b0ca6b504d2faad7a196&id=5d25137b6e&e=4b10910eed)

body:
Please read the following message from our sponsor.
* * *

| | | | [](https://click.em.dcdailyjournal.com/t/c/602cb6a7ebe94ac3b6502430aaaebbbe-6a1376f1ee954418a78682247467f6fa/63)
---
Friend,
Israel has welcomed home the 20 surviving hostages held captive in Gaza for the last two years. The bodies of many of the deceased hostages are also being returned. The people of Israel can now begin to heal from the trauma of their losses after two years of war and the anguish of antisemitic protests around the world accusing them of genocide and crimes against humanity.
The healing process will take time and will be overwhelming at times. The brutal war left communities broken. Homes were destroyed. Families displaced by violence are wondering how to rebuild and begin again.
**But for Israelis on the ground, the struggle continues. Recovery is only beginning.**
And **TODAY** is the moment when your compassion can shine brightest.
**[Please, give generously to the International Christian Embassy Jerusalem USA. Whether it’s $25, $50, $100, or whatever God places on your heart, your gift will go to work immediately where it's needed most across all of our vital programs bringing hope and support to the people of Israel.](https://click.em.dcdailyjournal.com/t/c/602cb6a7ebe94ac3b6502430aaaebbbe-6a1376f1ee954418a78682247467f6fa/63)**
---
[](https://click.em.dcdailyjournal.com/t/c/602cb6a7ebe94ac3b6502430aaaebbbe-6a1376f1ee954418a78682247467f6fa/63)

---
Your generosity today will uplift Israeli families by:
---
* **Rebuilding devastated communities** and giving families a fresh start.

* **Providing trauma counseling** for children and parents still gripped by fear.

* **Delivering food, clothing, and essentials** to families who lost everything.

* **Equipping volunteer responders** with protective gear to serve their neighbors.

* **Confronting the lies** and hate-filled propaganda against Israel influencing many young people.

---
**[Please, give generously now to the International Christian Embassy Jerusalem USA. Every single dollar brings healing and hope where it’s needed most.](https://click.em.dcdailyjournal.com/t/c/602cb6a7ebe94ac3b6502430aaaebbbe-6a1376f1ee954418a78682247467f6fa/63)**
---
[ **Stand with Israel Today – Give Now**](https://click.em.dcdailyjournal.com/t/c/602cb6a7ebe94ac3b6502430aaaebbbe-6a1376f1ee954418a78682247467f6fa/63)
---
Since our founding in 1980, the International Christian Embassy Jerusalem has stood with Israel in times of war and peace.

We have helped bring Jewish people home to Israel through Aliyah, placed bomb shelters in vulnerable towns, and comforted Survivors and victims of terror.

But our mission is not just about responding to crisis, it is about lifting Israel’s people in their moments of deepest need.

It is about advocating for them in halls of governments, universities, and in social media. It is about being a friend, blessing them, and giving them a reason to hope again. **[Please, give generously to the International Christian Embassy Jerusalem USA. Your gift of $25, $50, $100, or any amount God places on your heart will go to work immediately to help where it is needed most.](https://click.em.dcdailyjournal.com/t/c/602cb6a7ebe94ac3b6502430aaaebbbe-6a1376f1ee954418a78682247467f6fa/63)**

[](https://click.em.dcdailyjournal.com/t/c/602cb6a7ebe94ac3b6502430aaaebbbe-6a1376f1ee954418a78682247467f6fa/63)
---

---
This is your opportunity to send a powerful message: _You are not alone._

Your support restores dignity to a mother who wonders how she will care for her children.

It strengthens a father determined to rebuild his home.

It comforts a child who longs to feel safe again.
It encourages all the people of Israel that they are not alone.
This is what it means to bless Israel, not only in word, but in action. **[Will you help where it is needed most with your gift?](https://click.em.dcdailyjournal.com/t/c/602cb6a7ebe94ac3b6502430aaaebbbe-6a1376f1ee954418a78682247467f6fa/63)**

---
For Zion’s sake,

Susan M. Michael
International Christian Embassy Jerusalem USA President
